data.content: ["Matagorda offers a relaxed beach escape with excellent outdoor activities and local seafood dining, perfect for avoiding early mornings while enjoying scenic coastal walks without the nightlife pressure Alice wants to skip.", "Eureka Springs combines charming urban neighborhoods for leisurely exploration with strong local food scenes and cultural shopping, ideal for a laid-back 3-day trip with museums and no early starts or clubs.", "Beatty provides a relaxed small-town vibe with excellent outdoor scenic opportunities and a balanced food and urban experience, allowing the group to enjoy unhurried days without nightlife-focused activities.", "Hanksville delivers a perfect slow-paced outdoor destination with scenic walks through stunning landscapes and local dining, respecting the group's preference to avoid early mornings and club-heavy nightlife while satisfying relaxation needs.", "Clearwater Beach offers iconic beach relaxation with good food options and urban neighborhood exploration, though it's slightly more developed, it still provides the outdoor focus and dining experiences the group prioritizes without requiring nightlife participation."]
